title: Camso Recalls Yeti SnowMX Conversion Kits Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The brakes on the snow bike can fail after the conversion kit has been installed, posing a crash hazard to the user. Units: About 380.

title: Pass & Seymour Recalls Commercial-Grade Electrical Receptacles Due to Burn Hazard
summary: A manufacturing error within the receptacles could lead consumers to incorrectly force the plug into the receptacle, causing the plug blades to overheat, posing a burn risk to the consumer. Units: About 685,000.

title: Continuum Recalls Lenox Tea Kettles Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The tea kettles can expel hot water during use, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 56,000.

title: Joybird Recalls Dressers Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled dressers are unstable if not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that may result in death or serious injuries to children. The dressers do not comply with the performance requirements of the U.S. voluntary industry standard (ASTM 2057-17). Units: About 100.

title: Manhattan Toy Recalls Musical Lili Llama Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The screws used to attach the spinning flowers to the sides of the toy can become loose and fall off, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 4,000 (In addition, 63 in Canada).

title: Southern Motion Recalls "Wireless Power" Reclining Furniture Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion batteries used to power the "Wireless Power" reclining furniture can overheat, posing a fire hazard Units: About 2,300.

title: Stelpro Design Recalls Sonoma Wall Fan Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An internal part of the heater fails to meet flammability performance requirements, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,600.

title: VP Harrier and Giant Pinner Bicycle Pedals Recalled Due to Fall and Injury Hazards; Made by VP Components
summary: The pedal body can separate from the pedal spindle resulting in a loss of balance, posing fall and injury hazards for the rider. Units: About 5,400 (2,700 pairs) Harrier and Giant Pinner DH pedals.

title: BioFinest Recalls Wintergreen Essential Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning; Sold Exclusively at Biofinest.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 20.

title: Leviton Manufacturing Recalls Electrical Connection Devices Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The electrical connection devices can have mislabeled terminal markings, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 98,000 (In addition, about 4,400 units were sold in Canada).

title: LUS Recalls Hair Dryers Due to Electrocution or Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The hair dryers do not have an immersion protection device, posing an electrocution or shock hazard if the dryer falls into water when plugged in. Units: About 2,700 (In addition, about 410 were sold in Canada).

title: Natural Health Partners Recalls Dr. Mercola Wintergreen Essential Oils Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The products contain the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 5,6

title: Naturo Sciences Recalls Eiji Essentials Wintergreen Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 1,2

title: Dr. Adorable Recalls Sweet Birch Essential Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 12.

title: MTD Southwest Recalls Trimmers and Polesaws Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The head of the trimmers and polesaws can continue to rotate when the throttle is released, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 2,660.

title: Polaris Recalls Model Year 2018 to 2020 Ranger XP 1000 Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The clutch belt can break and damage the secondary clutch and the fuel line, posing a fire hazard to the rider. Units: About 80,000.

title: Polaris Recalls Model Year 2019 to 2020 Ranger XP 1000 Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fuel line can be misrouted above the bracket that protects the fuel line from a clutch belt failure, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,000.

title: Polaris Recalls PRO XD and Ranger Utility Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The seat belts on the vehicles can fail, posing an injury hazard to the user if they were to be in a collision or tip-over incident. Units: About 10,100 (In addition, 400 units were sold in Canada).

title: The Vitamin Shoppe Recalls Energy Formula Multivitamins Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The product is a dietary supplement containing iron which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 2,800.

title: Wyndmere Naturals Recalls Birch Sweet Essential Oil and Aches & Pains Synergistic Essential Oil Blend Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 2,8

title: Bellman & Symfon Recalls Flash Receivers for Reduced Hearing Persons; Unit Can Fail to Alert in an Emergency
summary: The back-up battery can fail to fully charge resulting in the receiver not working as intended and failing to flash to alert hearing-impaired persons to an emergency. Units: About 450.

title: Essential Trading Post Recalls Wintergreen and Birch Essential Oils Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The products contain the substance methyl salicylate which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products are not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 2

title: Modular Robotics Recalls Rechargeable Battery Packs Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The rechargeable battery packs can short circuit, causing them to overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,400.

title: Ximi Vogue Recalls Children's Neck Pillows Due to Violation of the Federal Lead Paint Ban; Risk of Poisoning
summary: Paint on the zippers and zipper pulls contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 160.
